model: HW2 Protocol Series humidity and temperature room sensor
applies_to: Veris HW2 Protocol Series wall humidity/temperature sensors (optional touchscreen) set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The HW2 is a wall room sensor that reports temperature and humidity over BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus, DIP-selectable). Touchscreen models add occupant setpoints for temperature and humidity, a fan speed selection, an occupancy override and display settings as writable values.
notes: Names with * are preserved through power outages; avoid writing them cyclically.
Touchscreen setpoint, fan speed, display and color objects only matter on touchscreen models.
The guide's range table also lists Temp Offset and Humidity Offset, but its objects table has no offset objects; the SpaceLogic SLP twin lists them as AV 7/AV 8.
Occupancy Override is active when the room is NOT occupied (as printed).
Source: HW2 Protocol Series Installation Guide Z207936-0K, objects table p7-8.

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and BACnet mode on the DIP switches, then read room temperature and humidity. On touchscreen models also read the occupant setpoint, fan speed and override.

minimum_points.name: Occupancy Override
minimum_points.why: Override button state: active = not occupied

setup: BACnet MS/TP on RS-485: DIP switch ADDRESS positions 1-7 set the MAC (0-127 for BACnet), position 8 selects BACnet or Modbus.
Baud rates for BACnet: 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800, set on the CONFIG DIP switch.
Device instance = Vendor_ID followed by the MS/TP address (e.g. 133nnn); it can be rewritten in the device object.
gotchas: Occupancy Override logic is inverted: active means not occupied.
Setpoint range is limited by each AV's Min/Max_Pres_Value (0-50 temp, 0-100 RH).

points.name: Select Temperature Display*
points.description: Main screen shows setpoint (active) or room temperature
points.states: 0=Room temp on main screen, 1=Setpoint on main screen

points.name: Display Setpoint*
points.description: Shows temperature setpoint on home screen
